title: Error estimate of the nonuniform BDF3-L2 method for subdiffusion equations via multiscale solution decomposition
summary: Numerical experiments reported by Quan and Wu [SIAM J Numer Anal 61 (2023) 2106-2132] show that the observed temporal convergence rates of nonuniform L2 methods for subdiffusion models are not consistent with the theoretically predicted order $3-α$. This discrepancy suggests that a more refined analysis is needed and motivates the development of a nonuniform BDF3-L2 method for the subdiffusion equation.
